title: Iberian lead-plaque lexicon: 40 lexical units with proposed meanings (not translations), certainty and provenance coding
citation: Martín Valladolid, David (2026). Iberian lead-plaque lexicon: 40 lexical units with proposed meanings (not translations), certainty and provenance coding. CLDF dataset. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24530083
description: Forty lexical units of the Iberian lead plaques (64 attested forms) with proposed meanings, certainty grades and provenance coding. Iberian is undeciphered: the meanings are proposals, not translations.
